about me

Data, systems, business — and the space in between.

I’m George Choulakis, a data and integration specialist with experience across retail, FP&A, e-commerce, reporting, and data engineering. I like turning complicated business processes into systems that are easier to understand, trust, and maintain.

LinkedIn ↗ Career timeline →

My work

My career has moved through commercial operations, finance, reporting, data engineering, and integration. That mix shaped the way I work today: I rarely see a technical problem as only technical. Usually there is also a process, a definition, a handover, or a business rule that needs to be understood first.

I work mainly with SQL, Power BI, Power Query, Python, PowerShell, Excel automation, and data integration workflows. I’m especially interested in reporting architecture, operational data, process automation, and internal tools that remove repetitive work.

Career in one sentence

From e-commerce and reporting at Philip Morris International, to data engineering at EY, FP&A reporting at Jack Wolfskin, and now sales data and integration at NEW YORKER — I’ve kept moving toward work where systems, data, and business decisions meet.

How I like to build

I care about the unglamorous details: naming things clearly, making failures visible, documenting logic, preserving history, and leaving a system understandable for the next person. A solution is more useful when people know what it does and why they can trust it.

Outside the database

Music has been part of my life for years. I sing, play guitar, almost always have white wired headphones nearby, and have a soft spot for cats, Playmobil figures, and rubber ducks with suspiciously strong debugging opinions.
